title: GitDealFlow Answers
description: Q&A answer pages from GitDealFlow, Track startup acquisitions & funding rounds

items.title: How do I track startup acquisitions in real time?
items.content_text: Truly real-time tracking of private startup acquisitions does not exist; the practical stack is public filings and press feeds plus leading indicators like GitDealFlow's weekly GitHub panel, which flags teams 21 to 47 days before rounds are announced.

items.title: What's the difference between GitDealFlow and Crunchbase?
items.content_text: Crunchbase is a broad company database updated from announcements; GitDealFlow is a leading-signal dataset of weekly GitHub engineering activity flagging breakout teams 21 to 47 days before their rounds.

items.title: How do investors use acquisition data to find opportunities?
items.content_text: Investors read acquisition history for patterns (serial acquirers, consolidation, multiples), then watch leading indicators: GitDealFlow's weekly GitHub panel flags accelerating teams 21 to 47 days before announcements.
